newsitem.title: USA: Polyphase files annual, qtly reports.
newsitem.headline: Polyphase files annual, qtly reports.

text.p: Polyphase Corp said Monday it had filed its annual 10-K and quarterly 10-Q reports for the periods ending December 31, 1996 and March 31, 1997, with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company, which agreed on February 3 to halt trading of its stock, said it expects its shares to resume on the American Stock Exchange Tuesday, June 17.
Last week Polyphase, a diversified holding company, issued a downward revision of its fiscal 1996 and first and second quarter 1997 results.
It reported a revised fiscal 1996 loss of $0.03 and a loss of $0.01 a share for the second quarter 1997.
Along with issuing the revised figures, the company also said that its independent auditors raised substantial doubts about its ability to continue as a going concern.
